title.en: Sales book and sales return book

body.en: The sales book records only credit sales of goods, from copies of invoices issued; each customer's account is debited and the total is credited to Sales Account. The sales return (return inwards) book records goods returned by customers, supported by credit notes; each customer is credited and the total is debited to Sales Return Account.
body.kn: ಮಾರಾಟ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲದ ಸರಕು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಒಟ್ಟು ಮಾರಾಟ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಮಾರಾಟ ವಾಪಸಾತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಿದ ಸರಕು; ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ನೋಟ್ ಆಧಾರ.

title.en: On the board: Which book does it go in?

say.en: Ask first: is it cash? Every cash transaction goes to the cash book.
On credit, and goods we deal in? Sales go to the sales book, returns from customers to the sales return book.
Anything else, like an asset sold on credit, goes to the journal proper.
Journal proper also takes opening, closing, adjustment and rectification entries.

title.en: Sales book, returns book or journal proper?

text.en: Sold goods on credit to Ravi
Sold goods on credit to Meena less trade discount
Ravi returned goods and we sent him a credit note
Owner took goods for personal use
Opening entry at the start of the year

explanation.en: Only credit sales of goods go to the sales book and their returns to the sales return book. Cash transactions go to the cash book. Credit sale of an asset, drawings of goods, loss by fire and opening entries go to the journal proper.

body.en: Transactions that do not fit any special book are recorded in the journal proper: opening entries, closing entries, adjustment entries, rectification of errors, transfer entries, credit purchase or sale of assets, goods withdrawn by the owner, goods lost by fire or theft, and goods given as free samples.
body.kn: ಯಾವುದೇ ವಿಶೇಷ ಪುಸ್ತಕಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಂದದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳು ಜರ್ನಲ್ ಪ್ರಾಪರ್‌ಗೆ: ಆರಂಭಿಕ, ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ, ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ, ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ನಮೂದುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳ ಸಾಲದ ಖರೀದಿ-ಮಾರಾಟ.

problem.en: Which book will Kumar Electricals use? (a) Sold fans on credit to Sai Stores ₹18,000; (b) Sai Stores returned fans worth ₹1,500; (c) sold old computer on credit to Ali ₹8,000; (d) sold fans for cash ₹6,000.

steps.en: (a) Credit sale of goods → sales book; Sai Stores Dr.
(b) Return by customer → sales return book; credit note to Sai Stores.
(c) Credit sale of an asset → journal proper: Ali Dr; To Computer A/c.

answer.en: Sales book, sales return book, journal proper, cash book

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. Which book will Kumar Electricals use? (a) Sold fans on credit to Sai Stores ₹18,000; (b) Sai Stores returned fans worth ₹1,500; (c) sold old computer on credit to Ali ₹8,000; (d) sold fans for cash ₹6,000.

body.en: First: cash or credit? Cash always goes to the cash book. Second, for credit: is it goods for resale? Goods go to the purchases or sales books (or their return books); anything else goes to the journal proper.
